_comment: Rotational (slump) Monte Carlo parameters. Units: meters (m), seconds (s), kg/m^3, degrees.

d0._comment: Target initial depth (positive, in meters) used to place the slide start s0: pick s0 where depth(s0) ~ d0.

L._comment: Slide length along the transect (m). Effective length L_eff may differ due to discretization.

T._comment: Thickness proxy T (m) used to set sagitta = sagitta_scale*T when building circular arc through endpoints.

strength._comment: Undrained strength control (dimensionless). Used by rotational_fs0_kcrit_eq10.

su_ratio._comment: Typical undrained strength ratio prior (tune this to make rotational more/less strict).

ru._comment: Pore-pressure reduction model for rotational case. Rur is sampled via sample_Rur(beta,...).

width._comment: Optional but recommended: used to compute failed-slide area/volume in your Step 7 maps.

hazard._comment: Return-period ramp used to query k(RP) from the hazard-fit NPZ. Units: years.

Dcrit_m._comment: Only used if mode='newmark_rs2009'. Bounded lognormal displacement capacity (m).
